methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: By water use, Google’s Botetourt site would be its 8th largest data center complex in the world
signals.signal_reading: Google's massive Botetourt data center signals concentrated AI infrastructure investment in a mid-tier region, but water-intensive operations suggest capital-heavy deployment rather than distributed local capability building or workforce development.

signals.title: Stafford Co. defers data center project on property with historic cemetery
signals.signal_reading: Stafford County's data center deferral reflects community pushback against infrastructure concentration in NoVA, potentially slowing but not reversing the geographic concentration of AI-enabling cloud infrastructure in the region.

signals.title: Testing service acquisition expands Virginia’s workforce credentialing and policy plans
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's acquisition of workforce credentialing testing services signals state-level investment in distributed skills validation infrastructure that could enable broader AI fluency measurement and certification across all regions.

signals.title: Fed’s Warsh taps broad group of Fed outsiders to oversee review
signals.signal_reading: Federal Reserve's AI impact review task force, likely drawing heavily on NoVA's concentration of financial tech expertise and federal contractors, reinforces deep capability clustering in metro DC-adjacent corridors rather than distributed knowledge.

signals.title: Remote work has its perks, but U.Va. study also finds mental health downsides
signals.signal_reading: UVA research on remote work mental health signals the shallow adoption layer of platform-mediated work tools spreading broadly, but focuses on usage effects rather than capability depth or economic opportunity distribution.
